segments.text:
V. 1.
A garden—Probably belonging to one of his Friends. He might retire to this private Place, not only for the Advantage of ſecret Devotion, but alſo that the People might not be alarmed at his Apprehenſion, nor attempt in the firſt Sallies of their Zeal, to reſcue him in a tumultuous Manner. Kedron was (as the Name ſignifies) a dark, ſhady Valley, on the Eaſt-ſide of J•r•ſalem, between the City and the Mount of Olives, thro' which a little Brook ran, which took its Name from it. It was this Bro•k, which David, a Type of Chriſt, went over, with the People, weeping, in his Flight from Abſalom.
